name: Starchess
author: László Polgár (Polgár Superstar Chess) / AGP port
description: László Polgár's commercial hex chess on a 37-cell hexagram with cells numbered 1-37. Only the five pawns start on the board: the king, queen, rook, bishop and knight are placed alternately by the players on their own back rank first, giving 14,400 different openings. There is no hex-diagonal movement at all — the rook moves only vertically, the bishop on the four oblique orthogonals, the queen on all six — and no castling or en passant.
